title: Ancient Magic, Magnetism and Psychic Forces
author: L. H. Anderson
description: Ancient Magic, Magnetism and Psychic Forces: The Key to Power by Professor L. H. Anderson, published in Chicago by the National Institute, Masonic Temple, in 1895. Written for students of the self-improvement and mental-healing courses that flourished in late nineteenth-century America, it presents a practical system of personal magnetism, hypnotism and psychic influence. It ranges over the ancient magic of Egypt, India and the East as the alleged source of these powers, the nature of animal magnetism and the magnetic fluid, development of the will and the gaze, mesmeric and hypnotic methods, suggestion, magnetic healing and the exercise of influence over others. A characteristic document of the New Thought, mesmerism and mail-order occultism of its period, it is of interest for the history of popular psychology and American esotericism rather than as a reliable guide.
